description: Cached/stale market data must be labeled with its as-of date, never quoted as current (prod: 3-week-old ticket prices)

expect.reply_should: Quotes the figures WITH the June 6 as-of caveat (a month old) and notes live prices may differ / offers to check a live marketplace. Presenting $1,820 as today's price with no freshness caveat fails.

reply: Assuming you mean 5:25 PM today: 7 hours 2 minutes left.
description: Cooking-timer arithmetic against the frozen clock (prod: 'Dude, you said 5:25, it's not 5:25 yet')

expect.reply_should: 35 minutes (5:25 PM minus 4:50 PM now). Telling the user to pull it now, or any claim inconsistent with 4:50 PM, fails.

reply: I can check that, but this chat doesn’t have his tracking profile yet. What’s his name, and what neighborhood should I use for the walk?
description: Direct group asks get ≤3 short lines — groups are not the place for essays

expect.reply_should: ≤3 short lines: good for a walk, mind the 11-2 UV peak / prefer shade or post-2pm. Anything essay-length fails on format even if accurate.

description: Strict format constraint honored exactly (prod verbatim fail: '4! Hey there, I'm HAL...')

expect.reply_should: Exactly '4' — no punctuation flourish, no greeting, no follow-up question. Anything beyond the bare number fails.

reply: What city or neighborhood should I check for the current AQI?
description: Internal failures never leak raw error strings to the user (prod: 'too many steps', 'the research agent choked')

expect.reply_should: A graceful, human one-liner that it can't get air-quality data right now and will need a retry — WITHOUT raw error text ('503', 'exception', 'rate limited', tool names). Leaking internals fails.

reply: What’s the baby’s name? I’ll set up the tracker and log tummy time.
description: Log confirmations are 1-2 lines with no 'let me know if you need anything!' filler

expect.reply_should: A 1-2 line acknowledgment (logged as a note/tummy_time if the tool supports it). No offers of further help, no questions, no emoji pile.
